messages:
Priya Rao: Hi everyone, I'm Priya (first day!). My calendar shows two "New Hire Orientation" events both at 09:00 but one is 09:00 NZDT and the other shows 09:00 local. The local one has no Zoom link, just an "Add conferencing" button. Which one should I join? I'm in Auckland. @Diego M any advice?

Diego M: Welcome Priya! :wave: Join the one that converts to 21:00 NZDT (global session). The duplicate is probably from mismatched timezone metadata in the ICS. If one has a Zoom link, that's the canonical invite.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Global New Hire Orientation at 09:00 AM ET. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/apr2026 Passcode: 7410. Recording will be uploaded to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings within 60 minutes after the session. If your invite lacks conferencing, check the PeopleOps calendar or post here.

Priya Rao: Thanks. Outlook desktop is showing both and they overlap. Mobile shows only one. The duplicate might be from our ATS adding a calendar entry too.

IT Support: Hey team —we see two common causes: (1) two schedulers created invites (one via the PeopleOps calendar, one via the ATS) with different timezone fields; (2) the ICS generator omitted conferenceData for one invite. Quick user fix: delete both and re-add from the invite that contains the Zoom link. We'll normalize and resend.

Asha: For folks on Teams/Outlook desktop: open the duplicate event -> Edit -> Time zone -> set explicit zone (Eastern Time) and save. That usually merges them. If ATS keeps creating an event, we should stop the ATS calendar sync.

Diego M: IT, can you resend the invite to new-hires-apr2026 and include the Zoom join URL and passcode in the description (not just conferenceData), and set event timezone explicitly to America/New_York for the global session? Also add a recorded-placeholder link: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/orientation-recordings/2026-04.

IT Support: Will do resending now with conferenceData/joinUrl, passcode in description, and timezone=America/New_York. Also disabling the ATS calendar auto-create for new-hires-apr2026 to avoid dupes. New invites should arrive in ~3 minutes. If you still see duplicates after that, remove both and re-add from the new invite, then DM screenshots and we'll escalate.

Priya Rao: New invite arrived, I removed the old ones and re-added. Zoom link and passcode visible, time correctly shows 21:00 here. Thanks everyone!

Asha: Confirmed fixed for me too. Recording placeholder is present. Welcome Priya! :tada:

PeopleOps Bot: Recording will be uploaded to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings within 60 minutes after session end. If you miss it, book a catch-up slot via the "New Hire Catch-up" calendar event.
